verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a full REST API (e.g. POST /rest/contracts) plus a dedicated API sandbox for testing without touching production data and webhooks for event-driven automation, all of which can be scripted headlessly outside any UI. However, there is no explicit CLI, CI/CD pipeline guide, or documented automated auth flow (e.g. service-account tokens) tailored to headless/CI use — the MCP server docs even note that most clients handle OAuth2 interactively.  missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD guidance, non-interactive auth/service-account setup, CLI tooling, and independent confirmation of automation use in CI.
